name: enumset-bench
description: The enum-set representation bench Tools/perf/enumset_bench.py and its Jet twin Tools/perf/enumset_bench/run.jet, #5072 c7: every refusal, each exit 2 with nothing on stdout (no --json, a bad count, a size out of range, a value that is not a number, an option without its value, an unknown option, an ambiguous option, an explicit-value help, an extra argument, arguments after `--`); a size that is not a number, exit 1; a run with a relative state root and `--jet sh` reaching the stand-in build script in the fixtures, so the Rust builds fail on the relative source path, one Jet arm runs and is measured, one exits 3 with a long non-ASCII stderr, one prints no phase timings and one fails its build with a long CRLF tail, and the report goes to a normalised --json path; and a run with an absolute state root that builds and measures both Rust arms with the real rustc and the allocation counter, so the BTreeSet arm is compared with rust_native for parity and ratios. The check prints the report as a JSON value with two-space indents, so it compares what the report says, not how its text escapes characters.
